# Fleet Quota Display (FQD)

> Open-source observability cockpit for multi-agent AI subscription fleets, proxy pools (CLIProxy), and API key budgets (LiteLLM). Unified quota tracking, dual-horizon radar, fleet headroom simulation, and real-time reset timers. Available as a self-hosted Docker container, PWA web panel, Chrome extension, and mobile app.

Fleet Quota Deck (FQD) solves a critical bottleneck for multi-agent systems (Firstmate, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode): teams and developers who pool multiple subscription accounts alongside pay-as-you-go API keys. Each account is tracked in full isolation—its own credentials, token rotation, and telemetry history—allowing operators to monitor fleet burn velocity and capacity on a single screen.

## Core Capabilities
- **Dual-Horizon Quota Radar**: Real-time visualization of 7-day rolling allowances alongside 5-hour session burst windows with second-by-second reset countdowns.
- **Fleet Headroom Simulator**: Interactive capacity modeling (10, 50, 100, All agents) to model burst resilience and prevent rate-limit blackouts before launching agent workloads.
- **CLIProxy & LiteLLM Integration**: Out-of-the-box discovery and synchronization of Antigravity, Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, and paid API key budgets (`/key/info`).
- **Strict Account Isolation**: Run 10+ accounts of the same provider with zero session cross-contamination, automated token rotation, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
- **DevOps & Production Security**: Prometheus `/metrics` export, Caddy automated TLS reverse-proxy profiles, strict SSRF guards, and unprivileged read-only Alpine Docker containers.

## Supported Providers
- **Antigravity (Google AI Pro)**: Session burst & weekly token caps.
- **Claude**: 5-hour session window, weekly window, Opus/Sonnet tier limits.
- **ChatGPT**: Codex 5-hour and weekly limits, credit balance, plan tiers.
- **Cursor & GitHub Copilot**: Premium request tracking.
- **DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral, Perplexity, Poe**.
- **LiteLLM & CLIProxyAPI**: Gateway telemetry and custom cURL recipes.

- Is there an open-source self-hosted alternative for monitoring AI subscription fleets?
